phases.name: MEMORY_SEMANTICS
phases.goal: Preserve Reality, Memory, Reflection, Weave, Dream, Imagine, Record, and Dawa distinctions.
phases.exit: No layer silently becomes another layer's authority.

phases.name: AVA_RECORD
phases.goal: Prove record schema, provenance, trust, integrity, self-test, callers, and storage.
phases.exit: Record system has real callers/storage and verifier semantics are evidenced.

phases.name: MODEL_AUTHORITY_WALL
phases.goal: Enforce model visibility without model self-authorization.
phases.exit: Model can observe outputs/context but cannot authorize consequential actions.

phases.name: BOARD_DOORS
phases.goal: Keep board as map and doors as commands without dashboard drift.
phases.exit: Human-facing board remains small, present, and choice-preserving.

phases.name: ADVERSARIAL_VERIFY
phases.goal: Attack paths, writes, symlinks, records, authority, stale paths, and remote/local divergence.
phases.exit: Negative-path evidence is recorded and unresolved edges are explicit.

phases.exit: VERIFY -> DIFF -> REVIEW -> COMMIT -> PUSH -> REMOTE_CONFIRM all pass.

core_law: ONE CONCEPT -> ONE CANONICAL NAME -> ONE CANONICAL ARTIFACT
Aliases may describe history or compatibility; aliases must not become new artifacts.
Name by semantic role first; style/poetry belongs inside the artifact, not in competing filenames.

web_8x.rule: Eight evidence roles, not eight copies of one source or eight correlated mirrors.
roles: PRIMARY: authoritative owner or maintainer source.
INDEPENDENT: separate origin that can confirm the claim.
COUNTER: disagreement, failure mode, issue tracker, or credible contrary evidence.
STANDARD: relevant standard, specification, or security guidance.
IMPLEMENTER: practical documentation or real implementation evidence from a distinct origin.
OPERATIONAL: observed real-world behavior, deployment, compatibility, or reproduction evidence.
EDGE: limits, exceptions, migration traps, or boundary conditions.
web_8x.independence_law: Repeated copies, mirrors, syndications, or summaries from one origin count as one source.

repo_2x.rule: Use one GitHub repository and two complementary repository passes.
passes: CURRENT_TREE: current branch/PR tree, active names, source, references, generated artifacts.
HISTORY_DIFF: base-to-head comparison, rename history, changed paths, prior semantic intent.
repo_2x.single_repo_law: Do not multiply repository count for the same product; cross branches, commits, and history inside the canonical repository.

runtime_1x.rule: For executable or safety-relevant decisions, exercise one bounded behavior path against the current tree.
required_when: integration or configuration can drift at runtime

cross_1x.rule: Perform one explicit WEB_8X <-> REPO_2X (+ RUNTIME_1X when applicable) crossing.
cross_1x.authority: The crossing is evidence comparison, not an authority source.

devil_cross_scope_2026_09_27.adaptive_rule: Skip non-applicable web roles for trivial deterministic facts; do not pad the count. Use the full scope for architecture, safety, external behavior, migration, and high-consequence changes.

dawa_notepad.purpose: Human-authored notes, drafts, references, scratch material, and files created outside Avalhla.
dawa_notepad.rule: Do not treat Dawa_Notepad as implicit Avalhla input. A file may enter Avalhla context only through an explicit bounded user-directed read or ingestion path.

avalhla_read_files.purpose: Canonical repository-controlled files intentionally placed in Avalhla's auto-read box.

sublime_workspace.editor_visibility_note: Showing both lanes in one Sublime project is an editor convenience only; it does not grant Avalhla runtime permission to read Dawa_Notepad.
sublime_workspace.project_file_role: machine-readable editor configuration template, not Avalhla authority
sublime_workspace.live_workspace_rule: Copy the project template into Dawa_Notepad before opening it so the Sublime .sublime-workspace remains outside the repository.

primary_language.rule: Use AvvA for current relation semantics. Preserve AwA only inside explicit historical evidence or migration history.

architecture_law: One canonical Avalhla auto-read lane: memory/auto-read/.
Do not create a parallel Avalhla/read-files directory while memory/auto-read/ remains the canonical auto-read artifact.
Dawa_Notepad remains outside the Avalhla repository and outside implicit auto-read.
Showing a file in an editor does not authorize model context ingestion.
Keep user-only material in Dawa_Notepad; keep Avalhla-owned read material in memory/auto-read/.

ask_only_when: A required implementation fact is absent from current CoBuilder state.
The live repository cannot establish the fact.
Existing evidence conflicts and Dawa's intent is genuinely required.
do_not_ask_when: The answer is already present in current CoBuilder state.
The answer can be verified from the live repository.
The issue is deterministic and can be resolved from source plus evidence.
co_builder_information_request_policy.persistence: Record each answered request with question_id, answer, source, recorded_at, and scope in this canonical CoBuilder JSON.
co_builder_information_request_policy.rerequest_rule: Never ask the same question_id again unless Dawa explicitly invalidates or changes the recorded answer.
co_builder_information_request_policy.current_status: No human clarification is required for the current PR/CI failure; repository and CI evidence were sufficient.
